mission_title: Governance Composer v1 — Shared Authorization Decision Spine: Structured Design Blocker
dirty_state_before: Steward plugin modified by parallel lane (preserved)
tests_intentionally_skipped: Design-phase audit only — implementation blocker documented. Tests deferred to implementation phase.
telemetry_and_redaction_implications: Composer would emit content-light GateDecision using existing governance_gate_decision schema. No raw content in composer output. Evidence store filesystem receipts are content-light by design.
dependency_changes: No new dependencies needed for composer. GovernanceRuntime, GovernanceEngine, GovernanceDecisionEvidence, FilesystemReceiptStore all exist.
completed_work: Audit: Proposal-vs-execution distinction — MUTATION_PROPOSAL exists as dead enum, MUTATION_EXECUTION is only produced mode
Audit: GovernanceRuntime can produce lawful allow for search_replace when wired with evidence store + session_rules for ALWAYS permission
Audit: GovernanceEngine.evaluate_action_legality() is functional — returns ALLOWED with allow_mutation=True, no blocked provider/dirty violations
Audit: RuntimeToolExecutionRunner ToolRuntime callback precedence — individual callbacks override policy_object via `or` chain
Audit: AgentLoop executor.py mode mapping is broken (always UNKNOWN) — gates 1/1.6/1.7 dead in AgentLoop path
Audit: CapabilityGate blocks both proposal and execution on SETUP_REQUIRED — no unlock() callers in Python

Decision: Authorize proposals first, defer execution admission. MUTATION_PROPOSAL skips unsolvable LocalActionEnvelopeGate while keeping meaningful authorization gates (profile, governance engine) active. search_replace currently uses MUTATION_EXECUTION — must change to MUTATION_PROPOSAL (one-line change in tool_runtime_adapter.py:102). Execution admission with signed envelopes, unlocked profiles, leases is separate concern.

Gate classification: 6 gates classified — (1) CapabilityGate: execution admission deferred; (2) GovernanceEngine: authorization decision; (3) LocalActionEnvelopeGate: execution admission deferred; (4) Permission/Approval: authorization decision input; (5) Dirty guard: downstream tool safety check; (6) Lease: coordination guard.

Build-vs-block decision: BLOCK — 5 structural barriers. Cannot implement narrow v1 composer without multi-file governance refactor: CapabilityGate profile lifecycle (no unlock callers), tool_runtime.py:391 allow_mutation hardcode (bypasses engine), executor.py:86-100 broken mode mapping (AgentLoop gates dead), evidence store wiring (GovernanceRuntime.evidence never set), RuntimeToolExecutionRunner callback injection (no permission_decision pass-through).
intentionally_deferred_work: Governance composer implementation — blocked by 5 structural issues: (1) CapabilityGate profile lifecycle — ProfileStore.unlock() has no Python callers, profile must be unlocked for isolated temp-repo tests; (2) tool_runtime.py:391 hardcodes allow_mutation=True, bypassing GovernanceEngine — must change to allow_mutation=False or plumb from composer decision; (3) executor.py:86-100 broken mode mapping makes AgentLoop gates dead — must fix for parity; (4) GovernanceRuntime.evidence never wired — must connect GovernanceDecisionEvidence(store=FilesystemReceiptStore(root)); (5) RuntimeToolExecutionRunner must accept permission_decision/approval_decision callbacks that override policy_object.
LocalActionEnvelopeGate satisfaction — requires public_key_provider and signed envelope infrastructure (execution-admission concern)
CapabilityGate profile lifecycle — requires ProfileStore.unlock() integration (execution-admission concern)
AgentLoop executor mode mapping fix — separate bug in executor.py:86-100
discovered_out_of_scope_risks: AgentLoop executor.py mode mapping is broken — all tools pass through with exec_mode=UNKNOWN, bypassing profile/governance/local-action-envelope gates. OpenCode bridge path is the ONLY path exercising these gates. Governance refactor must fix both paths.
MUTATION_PROPOSAL has zero gate-behavioral meaning beyond skipping Gate 1.7 — both modes trigger identical profile and governance engine checks. Enum needs distinct semantics.
ToolRuntime gate 1.6 hardcode (allow_mutation=True) silently bypasses GovernanceEngine for ALL callers. Fix may surface previously-hidden governance denials in AgentLoop path.

5 implementation blockers: CapabilityGate profile (no unlock callers), allow_mutation hardcode (tool_runtime.py:391), executor mode mapping (always UNKNOWN), evidence store not wired (GovernanceRuntime.evidence=None), runtime callback injection missing (ToolRuntime receives no permission_decision).
remaining_seams: 5 structural blockers before composer implementation viable
AgentLoop and RuntimeToolExecutionRunner must consume same composer boundary
OpenCode bridge must carry composer-issued decision identifier in result envelope
